_comment: Push notification credentials for the home node. For desktop packages, keep this file + AuthKey_*.p8 + serviceAccountKey.json at the repo root; scripts/build-desktop.sh and build-desktop.ps1 copy them into the Tauri node bundle (resources/node/). At runtime the home node loads them via ENVOYMESH_NODE_BUNDLE_DIR. You can also copy this file to <profileDir>/push-config.json for a post-install override. Env vars (APNS_KEY_ID, FCM_PROJECT_ID, etc.) still take priority. Profile dir locations: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/EnvoyMesh/profile/, Linux ~/.local/share/EnvoyMesh/profile/, Windows %APPDATA%/EnvoyMesh/profile/, dev ./data/default/.
_comment_paths: File paths (keyPath, serviceAccountJsonPath) support BOTH absolute and relative. Relative paths resolve against the directory where push-config.json was loaded (repo root in dev, resources/node in a packaged DMG/exe, or the profile dir for overrides). Drop your .p8 key and service-account JSON next to push-config.json and reference them by filename.

apns._comment_topic: topic = the app's bundle ID (Apple calls it 'APNs topic'). Must match the Bundle Identifier in Xcode.
apns._comment_voipTopic: voipTopic = bundle ID + '.voip'. Optional — auto-derived from topic if omitted.
apns._comment_sandbox: sandbox = true for debug / flutter install (development signing). false for App Store / TestFlight production builds.
